title: Points to Watch in Practicing the Way - Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
series: Points to Watch in Practicing the Way
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the opening paragraph of Dogen's Gakudo Yojinshu, "Points to Watch in Practicing the Way," in Shohaku Okumura's translation, on the first day of sesshin. Nomon starts with the roles people hold in the zendo, telling of a devoted timekeeper who was upset at being rotated out, and of Fu, a fierce ino who became a gentle shuso. After a sketch of Dogen's life and the centuries his writings sat on altars unread, Nomon reads the chapter on arousing Bodhi mind as the mind that sees impermanence, and describes a Tendai marathon monk who stood for 49 days. Enjoying Laura's cooking is fine, since nobody needs a jar for the evening breeze.
